decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-94 MODIFY already fully captures the client's edit-finalization target and the condition for starting final revisions; no addition or edit is required.
The client announces forthcoming comments and Canva content edits but does not change photo selection, integration, or treatment.
The source does not identify any table replacement, formatting change, or other modification to table integration.
The timing of final revisions does not alter the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional in the saved proposal.
Although the client plans to edit content, the source does not state that those edits change the page-limit goal, reduction approach, or unmet-limit action.
The source schedules forthcoming comments and final edits but does not yet specify any change to layout or graphic treatment.
The client's intention to edit content in Canva is consistent with the existing editable-source requirement and does not change its platform, access, ownership, or asset policy.
The source does not identify specific narrative changes or resolve the existing uncertainty about Section 6; the candidate remains unchanged.
The revision timing does not change the required final PDF format, file count, email submission method, or export quality.
The source does not change the Agua Arc brand identity or the brand assets applied to the proposal.
The source does not mention or change the cover letter's one-page requirement.
The source concerns final edits to the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and has no effect on the TPEC proposal-design requirement.
